questions.q: What are some less obvious ways depression can manifest according to the text?
a: Loss of interest, insomnia, or numbness
Sudden anger, excessive laughter, or paranoia
Physical pain, memory loss, or hallucinations
Overeating, daydreaming, or restlessness
questions.why: The overview lists these as ways depression may come dressed up, unlike obvious clues like tears.

questions.q: What does the text suggest you do when your brain is flooded with negativity?
a: Zoom out and take charge of your thoughts
Write down every negative thought in a journal
Immediately seek professional medical help
Ignore the thoughts until they pass on their own
questions.why: The faulty thinking lesson says to zoom out and take charge when thoughts become inaccurate.

questions.q: According to the text, what kind of stories can help inspire someone in depression?
a: Stories from people who went through similar or different traumatic events
Only stories from celebrities who overcame depression
Fictional stories about characters facing adversity
Stories from people who never experienced any negative events
questions.why: The lesson on other people's stories says to look for inspiring journeys from similar or different cases.

questions.q: According to the text, what is one benefit of setting boundaries by saying no?
a: It makes room for other activities you can respond to with yes
It eliminates all feelings of guilt toward others
It guarantees that people will never ask again
It replaces the need for any form of self-care
questions.why: The say no lesson explains that boundaries make room for other activities you can say yes to.

questions.q: What does the text say about the accuracy of your thoughts during depression?
a: They can become inaccurate and not all should be trusted
They are always accurate but feel overwhelming
They become completely silent and unresponsive
They only affect your physical health, not your emotions
questions.why: The faulty thinking lesson states that when the brain is flooded with negativity, thoughts can become inaccurate.
